examples.english: They took Karim to the doctor quickly.
examples.transliteration: Homa waddaw Karim lel doktor be sor3a.

examples.arabic: بعدين قامت ليلى بسرعة وراحت أوضتها.
examples.english: Then Layla got up quickly and went to her room.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein amet Layla be sor3a we rahet odetha.

examples.english: They went to their houses quickly.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: قلوبنا كانت بتدق بسرعة في آخر دقايق من الماتش.
examples.english: Our hearts were beating fast in the last minutes of the match.
examples.transliteration: Oloobna kanet betde' be sor'a fi akher da'ayeq mel matsh.

examples.arabic: انا بشرب شاي الصبح بسرعة في البيت عشان متاخر
examples.english: I drink tea in the morning quickly in the house because I am late.
examples.transliteration: Ana bashrab shay el sobh bsoraa fi el beit ashan metakhar.

examples.arabic: عمر بيقول باصي الكورة ليا بسرعة
examples.english: Omar says pass the ball to me quickly.
examples.transliteration: omar beyool bassy el kora leya besoraa
